tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind the panels and the page ground. Ink, ink-muted and ink-faint read on it.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Toolbar, model tree, inspector, results drawer, tables and status bar. The default ground for all text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Overlays that float above the viewport or a panel: menus, popovers, dialogs, the contour legend. Always paired with shadow-float.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells, table header rows and group headers inside a panel. Ink, ink-muted and ink-faint read on it.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for tree rows, table rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected tree row or table row. Ink, ink-muted and ink-link read on it. The same item is drawn in elem-selected in the viewport.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: Background of the 3D/2D model view. Every elem-* color is at least 3:1 on it.

tokens.name: viewport-grid
tokens.usage: Ground grid and axis ticks in the viewport. Decorative only, never carries information.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on surface-panel, surface-canvas, surface-sunken, surface-hover and surface-selected.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, secondary labels, column headers and counts on surface-panel, surface-canvas, surface-sunken, surface-hover and surface-selected.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, empty-state text and hints on surface-panel, surface-canvas and surface-sunken. Disabled controls may go lighter; nothing else.

tokens.name: ink-link
tokens.usage: Text links and the active tab label on surface-panel, surface-canvas and surface-selected.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover fills. Flips to dark in the dark theme because action lightens there.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels, rows and groups. Decorative; use border-control for anything that must be seen.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on surface-panel and surface-canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with a 2px offset, on every interactive element and on surface-panel, surface-canvas and viewport. At least 3:1 on each.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The logo teal. Identity color for the mark, large shapes and accents (3:1 on surfaces). Not for body text and not as a button fill under text; use action or ink-link.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons and selected toggles, with on-action text. Derived from brand, darkened in light and lightened in dark so the label keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons, with on-action text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one warm highlight: selection in the viewport, the current result marker, and the cover. Use sparingly; one accent item per view. Not a status color.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Check passed, analysis complete. Text and icon on surface-panel, surface-canvas and status-ok-bg. Always shown with the check icon and a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Badge fill behind status-ok text.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Near limit, stale results, warnings. Text and icon on surface-panel and status-warn-bg. Always with the warning icon and a word.

tokens.name: status-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Badge fill behind status-warn text.

tokens.name: status-fail
tokens.usage: Check failed, analysis error, unstable model. Text and icon on surface-panel and status-fail-bg. Always with the cross icon and a word. Green and red are separated by hue only, so the icon and word are required.

tokens.name: status-fail-bg
tokens.usage: Badge fill behind status-fail text.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, running jobs. Text and icon on surface-panel and status-info-bg. Always with the info icon.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Badge fill behind status-info text.

tokens.name: elem-point
tokens.usage: Geometry points (model.points) drawn on viewport.

tokens.name: elem-line
tokens.usage: Geometry lines (model.lines) on viewport. Members are told apart by their design template in the inspector, not by color.

tokens.name: elem-polygon
tokens.usage: Geometry polygons (model.polygons) on viewport: outline in this color, face filled at 20% opacity of it.

tokens.name: elem-mesh
tokens.usage: Mesh nodes and elements when the Mesh display option is on. Thinner than elem-line.

tokens.name: elem-gridline
tokens.usage: Grid-system lines and their bubbles on viewport, drawn dash-dot. Bubble labels use ink.

tokens.name: elem-support
tokens.usage: Point-support symbols (fixed, pinned, rollers) on viewport.

tokens.name: elem-release
tokens.usage: Member-end release symbols on viewport.

tokens.name: elem-axis
tokens.usage: Local-axes triads when the Orientation display option is on; label each axis y or z in text.

tokens.name: elem-load
tokens.usage: Load arrows (point and distributed) on viewport. Never used for anything but loads.

tokens.name: elem-reaction
tokens.usage: Reaction arrows when the point result is Reactions. A different hue from elem-load so applied and resulting forces are never confused.

tokens.name: elem-selected
tokens.usage: Selected points, lines and polygons on viewport (the geometry ids of the active component). Pair with a heavier line, not color alone.

tokens.name: elem-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered item in the viewport and its row in the tree.

tokens.name: elem-undeformed
tokens.usage: Undeformed geometry drawn dashed when the Deformed shape display option is on.

tokens.name: elem-deformed
tokens.usage: Deformed shape on viewport, drawn solid over elem-undeformed.

tokens.name: contour-1
tokens.usage: Lowest 1/9 of a sequential result range (displacements, utilization). Same in both themes. The dark end is faint on the dark viewport, so draw mesh edges over contour fills.

tokens.name: contour-2
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 2 of 9.

tokens.name: contour-3
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 3 of 9.

tokens.name: contour-4
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 4 of 9.

tokens.name: contour-5
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 5 of 9 (midpoint).

tokens.name: contour-6
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 6 of 9.

tokens.name: contour-7
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 7 of 9.

tokens.name: contour-8
tokens.usage: Sequential result ramp, step 8 of 9.

tokens.name: contour-9
tokens.usage: Highest 1/9 of a sequential result range.

tokens.name: div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Strongest negative end of a diverging result range (axial N, shear Vy and Vz, torsion Mx, bending My and Mz). In this model sagging bending is negative; say so in the legend.

tokens.name: div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Weak negative side of a diverging range.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Zero on a diverging range.

tokens.name: div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Weak positive side of a diverging range.

tokens.name: div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Strongest positive end of a diverging range.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states, splash and report covers. Never inside a working panel.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page or dialog title, and the title of a generated design report.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading inside a dialog, report or drawer.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Item title at the top of the inspector: the component entry's name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select a member to edit its properties.
styles.usage: Help text, dialog copy and report prose.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default for tree rows, table cells, buttons and inspector labels. The working size of the app.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside ui text: selected row label, group totals, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels and column headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status bar text, legend ticks, axis labels and timestamps. Smallest size; never below this.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Panel and tree group titles. Type in sentence case; the component sets uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numeric values in tables and the inspector, with tabular figures so decimals line up.

styles.name: data-mono
styles.usage: Point coordinates, line point-id pairs, template ids and enum values (local-z, x-roller) where character alignment matters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks inside a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls; row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body padding; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between panels in floating layouts.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section spacing in dialogs, reports and empty states.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large gaps in reports and splash screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins in report and print layouts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tree and table rows, inputs, chips, scrollbar thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating overlays and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and toggle tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The only shadow. Floating overlays on the viewport, menus and dialogs. Docked panels use border, never shadow.

layout.note: Dimensions of the viewer skeleton. Apps may resize panels at runtime; these are the defaults and the values a panel resets to.

tokens.name: layout-toolbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top toolbar.

tokens.name: layout-statusbar
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom status bar.

tokens.name: layout-left
tokens.usage: Default width of the left model tree panel.

tokens.name: layout-right
tokens.usage: Default width of the right inspector panel.

tokens.name: layout-bottom
tokens.usage: Default height of the bottom data drawer when open.

tokens.name: layout-row
tokens.usage: Tree row and table row height.

tokens.name: layout-row-compact
tokens.usage: Row height in dense results tables.

tokens.name: layout-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: layout-control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and inputs inside panels and toolbars.
